title: Nystr\"om Attention Matches Full Attention for Cross-Sectional Stock Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.08106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MASTER's inter-stock multi-head attention -- the module responsible for modeling cross-sectional stock relationships -- accounts for 42.5% of model parameters and 25% of predictive value. We systematically decompose this module and uncover a surprising structure: the learned attention is near-uniform (perplexity 278/300), yet forcing exact uniformity eliminates all cross-sectional discrimination. Spectral analysis resolves this paradox: the deviation from uniformity is low-rank (effective rank ~65, top-10 modes capture 96.5% of energy), explaining why sparse approximations consistently fail while Nystrom low-rank attention (m=32 landmarks) matches full O(N^2) attention at O(mN) cost -- certified equivalent via TOST at both N=300 (5 seeds, Rank IC p=0.003) and N=800 (10 seeds, Rank IC p=0.034). translated_title: Nyström注意力在横截面股票预测中可媲美全注意力
translated_abstract: MASTER的股票间多头注意力——负责建模横截面股票关系的模块——占据模型参数的42.5%和预测价值的25%。我们系统地分解了该模块，并揭示出一个令人惊讶的结构：学习到的注意力接近均匀分布（困惑度为278/300），然而强制其完全均匀却会消除所有横截面判别能力。谱分析化解了这一悖论：偏离均匀性的部分是低秩的（有效秩约为65，前10个模态捕获了96.5%的能量），这解释了为何稀疏近似始终失败，而Nyström低秩注意力（m=32个地标点）却能以O(mN)的成本匹配完整的O(N²)注意力——并通过TOST等效性检验在N=300（5个随机种子，Rank IC p=0.003）和N=800（10个随机种子，Rank IC p=0.034）两种设置下均验证了等效性。其他发现包括：(i)注意力与收益率相似性呈负相关（Spearman rho = -0.614；在行业标签子集上为-0.645……
tldr: 该研究通过谱分析发现MASTER模型中股票间注意力偏离均匀分布的部分本质上是低秩的，因此Nyström低秩注意力可以以更低的计算复杂度完全替代全注意力模块，实现等效的横截面股票预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through spectral analysis that the deviation from uniformity in MASTER's inter-stock attention is inherently low-rank, enabling Nyström low-rank attention to fully replace the full attention module with lower computational cost while achieving equivalent cross-sectional stock prediction performance.
